pending_commit.commit_message: modemfwd: refactor installed firmware version info This moves the firmware version information into ModemHelper because modem vendors will potentially rely on vendor-specific commands to accurately report this information. We can hide this behind the Modem interface in order to allow easy transitioning to a more sane interface in the future, such as one where all version information is reported via ModemManager/shill. As a result of this, some stubs and mocks can go away and ModemFlasher no longer needs to have any information about the helper directory.
